{{Quote|It's certainly not Mon Calamari, but at least Ando is familiar. The moist air and open waters, shallow as they are, do my heart good.|[[Sissalik]]|<ref name="WM" />}}
'''Ando''' was an [[Ocean/Legends|oceanic]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Ando system/Legends|Ando system]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. It was also the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] species.

==Description==
[[File:Aqualish_DC.png|thumb|left|160px|An [[Ualaq/Legends|Ualaq]] Aqualish]]
Ando developed a single [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] known as the [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] early in galactic history. Originating from the sea which covered 95 percent of the world, they began to establish permanent settlements on what little land remained and supplemented it with sailing ships that doubled as mobile homes. The Aqualish developed into three subspecies, the Aquala, the Ualaq and the Quara. The majority of the world's islands were sustained by a decaying swamp ecosystem and covered in steamy mist.<ref name="WM" />

Ando and [[Andoan Free Colonies/Legends|her colonies]] were together known as the [[Spiverelda/Legends|Spiverelda]], which throughout its history was alternately ruled by the Aqualish and the distantly-related [[Harch/Legends|Harch]] of nearby [[Secundus Ando/Legends|Secundus Ando]]. The government tended towards turbulence and violence.<ref name="Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

==History==
===Early history===
The Aqualish evolved into three races which were constantly at war with each other: the Aquala, the baseline race of the oceans, the Quara of the wetlands, and the Ualaq of the caves and dark rain forests. Each race believed they were the dominant branch, leading to the [[Aqualish Civil War]]. Beginning with allegations leveled by the Aquala that the other two races caused a decline in the harvests of fish, the war ultimately ended in a treaty which saw the unification of all three races. After the war ended, a group of [[Human/Legends|Human]] settlers stumbled upon the world and were killed by the startled and aggressive Aqualish. Confiscating the ship which brought the supposed invaders to the world, the Aqualish extrapolated the secrets of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] travel from the exploratory craft and set forth on a campaign of conquest to the neighboring world of [[Andando]]. Not long after the landing, Andando was left a smoldering ruin, rendered inhospitable by the barbarous Aqualish.<ref name="WM" />

===Galactic Republic===
Discovered by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Great Manifest Period/Legends|Great Manifest Period]], envoys attempted to make contact with the inhabitants of Ando and were rebuked with hostile fire. This quickly led to the [[Aqualish–Republic War]] that, while bloody, quickly ended in the defeat of the Aqualish. Defeated, Ando joined the Republic in [[15,000 BBY/Legends|15,000 BBY]], the beginning of the [[Kymoodon Era]]. During the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]], Ando was attacked an conquered by the [[Sith Empire (Exar Kun)/Legends|Sith empire]] as part of the [[Krath Holy Crusade]]. While the Empire was defeated and Ando returned to the Republic, it was [[Battle of Ando (New Sith Wars)|claimed]] by the [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]] during the [[New Sith Wars]]. Following the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformation]], Ando returned to the Republic again.

In [[102 BBY/Legends|102 BBY]], the Aqualish colonized [[Andosha II]] and and numerous other planets in the [[Lambda sector/Legends|Lambda sector]].<ref name="HNN49">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|49|regional/13328_1.html|Andoan Free Colonies Criticize Aqualish}}</ref> From [[57 BBY/Legends|57 BBY]], however, the colonies attempted to declare independence of the [[Spiverelda/Legends|Spiverelda]] government based on Ando, forming the [[Andoan Free Colonies/Legends|Andoan Free Colonies]]. Backed by [[Secundus Ando/Legends|Secundus Ando]], Ando attempted to regain its colonies in the [[Andoan Wars/Legends|Andoan Wars]] until the Galactic Republic intervened in [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]]. The two sides were separated, but due to the constant violence erupting across the world, the Republic dispatched the [[Ando Demilitarization Observation Group]] to ensure the de-escalation of violence; [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Jorus C'baoth]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] served as one of the group's primary observers.<ref name="WM" />

===Clone Wars===
[[File:QuantillCity-HoloNetNewsVol531-45.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Aqualish celebrate the secession of Ando in [[Raquish Thoroughfare]]]]
Represented in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] by [[Po Nudo/Legends|Po Nudo]] before the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]], the memory of the defeat in the Andoan Wars was still raw on Ando, and the world [[Ando separation|seceded]] in [[23 BBY/Legends|23 BBY]] along with [[Sy Myrth/Legends|Sy Myrth]], a move contested by the Andoan Free Colonies, which retained representation in the Senate under [[Gorothin Vagger]].<ref name="HNN49" /><ref name="Hnn-Quick Poll">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|47||Quick Poll}}</ref> Under the leadership of Ualaq [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] Po Nudo and [[First Minister (Commenor)|First Minister]] [[Daragi Hoba]], Ando touched off a string of secessionist worlds that would later form the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. Nudo became a prominent Separatist leader and a member of the [[Separatist Council/Legends|Separatist Council]]. As the war spread across the galaxy, a [[Battle of Ando|civil war]] broke out across the world between both Nudo and Vagger's factions. Assisted by the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] and Jedi Master [[Shaak Ti/Legends|Shaak Ti]], the battle ended in a Separatist victory.<ref name="Republic HoloNet News Core Edition 14:3:22">{{InsiderCite|66|Republic HoloNet News Core Edition 14:3:22}}</ref>

===Imperial era===
{{Quote|As we say on Mon Calamari, swim where you want, but excrete in your own pool. The Empire's been excreting into the Aqualish pool for years, and if my guess is right, they might have a revolt on their hands soon.|Sissalik|<ref name="WM" />}}
[[File:Outer_Rim_Hunter.jpg|thumb|right|250px|An Aqualish bounty hunter]]
After the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], former Separatist worlds suffered heavily from intense Imperial scrutiny. Appointing an Aquala Senator to replace the recently murdered Nudo, the Senator served until the disbanding of the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]]. Establishing an Imperial garrison on the world, the Imperials ravaged the worlds natural resources, using them to further the Empire's war machine. Following the death of [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], Ando joined the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] only to fall into the sight of one of [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Mitth'raw'nuruodo's]] [[Battle of Ando (Thrawn campaign)|feint attacks]] in preparation for his attack on [[Ukio/Legends|Ukio]]. Sending the [[Bellicose (Imperial-class)/Legends|''Bellicose'']] in [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]], the world was taken by the [[Thrawn's confederation|Empire]].<ref name="EA" />

===Yuuzhan Vong War===
{{Quote|They've gone mad. They're destroying droids all over the city!''"<br />"''They aren't mad. They're just frightened. The Yuuzhan Vong are on Ando, and may well conquer the planet.|A [[Unidentified 3D-4 administrative droid|3D-4 droid]] and [[Dorsk 82]]|<ref name="EOV" />}}
During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], Ando was [[Invasion of Ando (Yuuzhan Vong War)|attacked]] by the [[Yuuzhan Vong|invaders]] but was issued an ultimatum: surrender a member of the [[New Jedi Order|Jedi Order]] and destroy all droids on the planet and the Yuuzhan Vong would leave in peace. The Aqualish quickly turned on visiting [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Dorsk 82]], but this was ignored by [[Warmaster]] [[Tsavong Lah]] and an invasion and occupation of their planet ensued, enslaving the race to the foreign invaders. After the war's end, the Yuuzhan Vong abandoned the planet, thus freeing the Aqualish from occupation.<ref name="EOV" />

Ando remained independent and disunited, and therefore never joined the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]]. As of [[137 ABY]], Ando was a member of [[Darth Krayt]]'s [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="EA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The PC game [[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']] mistakenly places Ando in the [[Fakir sector/Legends|Fakir sector]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Galactic Core]]. The Fakir Sector is actually located in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]. Moreover, ''[[Star Wars: Rebellion: Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]'' includes an appendix of all sectors and planets appearing in the game, but where the planet Ando would otherwise be included, the strategy guide strangely refers to the planet "Abdrim" instead of Ando, which is not a planet that appears in the game.
